title: U.S. Cash Open 15m Opening-Range Breakout — Crypto Perpetuals
mechanism_statement: The 09:30 America/New_York U.S. equity core open injects concentrated cross-asset information and liquidity demand; the first confirmed break of the 09:30–09:45 ET crypto range may continue directionally over the next 60 minutes.
failure_mode: The U.S. cash open is contemporaneous noise for crypto or the initial range is rapidly mean-reverted/whipsawed after costs.

market_clock.eligible_days: NYSE/Nasdaq regular U.S. cash trading weekdays excluding full-day closures

rule.opening_range: high=max(highs of 09:30,09:35,09:40 bars); low=min(lows of same bars)
rule.signal: first completed 5m bar from 09:45 through 11:25 ET whose close is strictly above OR high or strictly below OR low
rule.side: LONG above OR high; SHORT below OR low
rule.exit: close of the 12th 5m bar starting with the entry bar

discovery_gate.cluster_bootstrap: resample U.S. trading dates with all cross-sectional trades preserved; 5000 reps; seed 20260923
discovery_gate.on_pass: DISCOVERY_SURVIVES_ONLY; 2024 stays sealed pending separate prospective OOS authorization
discovery_gate.on_fail: CLOSE_EXACT_NO_EDGE or INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE; no reversal/filter/horizon rescue
